title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-12-10
source: Restored version of source ID 5801 (MSR > Cass x 3 > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN) by Droncit; Diamond Cut 8.5 Forensics was used for equalization and virtual valve simulation, an enhancer and some slight noise reduction.

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a standout Other One jam, though the source has an odd timing glitch.
ai_review.review: The show shines with a scorching The Other One that many fans cite as one of the coolest early‑70s jams, and overall playing is praised. However, listeners have noted that the recording runs about two minutes longer than expected, likely due to a repeated segment, which detracts from an otherwise solid soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: One glowing review highlights excellent performance; another flags a significant timing error that affects listening experience. With limited feedback, the combined show and recording assessment lands in the mid‑range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Timing discrepancy adds ~2 extra minutes to The Other One, likely due to a repeated section; no comments on overall clarity or mix.
